tasks.subject: Task 2: Create the PropsCard component
tasks.description:
**Goal:** new standalone PropsCard component renders one property as a two-tier card with badges, actions, meta strip, and a left accent stripe by most-severe status.

**Files:**
- Create: projects/maia-props/src/lib/props-dashboard/components/props-card/props-card.ts
- Create: projects/maia-props/src/lib/props-dashboard/components/props-card/props-card.html
- Create: projects/maia-props/src/lib/props-dashboard/components/props-card/props-card.scss

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- property = input.required<PropertyResponseDto>(); edit/remove/history outputs
- selector maia-props-card
- top tier: name, value (wrap not truncate), badges, 3 action buttons matching old aria-labels/disabled logic
- badges: exactly one Overridden/Default, plus Redundant/Overdue when true
- bottom tier: Source/Modified by/Modified/Review date strip, same DatePipe formats, em-dash for null (not Source)
- accent stripe: overdue>redundant>overridden>default using --mat-sys-* tokens
- host has data-testid property-card-<name>
- compiles
